description: This is a C# source file that defines an ASP.NET Core Web API controller named SchedulesController, which manages CRUD operations for schedule entities related to preventive maintenance. The controller includes methods for retrieving all schedules, retrieving a schedule by ID, creating, updating, and deleting schedules, with appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: SchedulesController
classes.description: API controller for managing schedules related to preventive maintenance, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of schedules, optionally filtered by asset ID, ordered by the next scheduled run.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific schedule by its ID, returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new schedule entity from the provided DTO and returns the created schedule with its new ID.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing schedule identified by ID with new data, returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a schedule by ID, returns 404 if not found.
